rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for “nothing” or “not anything.”

example.english: There is nothing in my bag.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 doi6 jap6 min6 mou5 je5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that there is absolutely nothing at all.

example.english: There is absolutely nothing in the fridge.
example.jyutping: syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 mat1 dou1 mou5
